title: Food-safe mugs
note: A short invented chat. Scored spellings are in the replaced turns. One spelling is only in the kept tail.

messages.content: The mugs have to be food-safe.
Fire to cone 6. The glaze is 40 feldspar, 30 silica, 20 whiting, 10 clay.
Call the glaze Ash Meadow. Do not call it Lead White.
Ash Meadow it is. Lead White is rejected. The test tile is number T-12.
How do we know a firing failed?
A shelf waster means that firing is scrap.
I will load the kiln Friday.
